breakdown.description: Counterflow configuration is stated but the parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences are used.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly retains the parallel-flow LMTD expression and the incorrect temperature differences (ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,in and ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,out). For a counterflow heat exchanger, these should be ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,out and ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,in, as specified in the ground truth. The agent repeated the original error verbatim.
